title: fix(spec): os migrate meta --stored lists a stored object bound external to a stored or registered managed datasource
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6zwDuV2XvoDkqC7bXgqnpc)_

Fixes #25279

Clause-②: yes (widening)

Metadata-protocol: none

The stored-shape listing for `object-external-binding-managed-datasource-refused` resolved an object's named datasource only from the stack being converted. `os migrate meta --stored` hands the chain one stored row at a time, so for a stored object row the listing could judge only a binding on the primary datasource (`'default'`). The object save door from #25257 also refuses a binding on a datasource stored or registered beside the object, so the pass missed exactly the rows whose next save is refused.

This takes the card's first branch: the pass hands down the datasource the door would read, and the detector judges it through the same predicate.

- **One read for both:** a new private `externalBindingDatasourceDefinition(name)` in `protocol.ts` is the `readMetaItem({ type: 'datasource', name })` read that `externalBindingSaveRefusal` already did inline (the environment's stored row, else the definition the code layer registers). The object half of the save door now calls it, and so does the pass, so the two cannot judge a binding against different datasources.
- **The pass:** `migrateStoredMetadata`, for each non-flow row, asks `storedRowKnownDatasources(singular, body)`. For an `object` row with `external` and a named `datasource`, it resolves that one datasource and passes it down as a one-entry map through `convertStoredItemDetailed` → `applyConversionsToStoredItem`. Any other row passes nothing. A failed read propagates, as it does at the door.
- **`@objectstack/spec`:** an optional `ApplyConversionsOptions.knownDatasources`, a read-only map from datasource name to that datasource's definition (only its `schemaMode` is read), which `StoredConversionOptions` inherits. `applyConversions` hands it to `reportRefusedStoredShapes` as a `RefusedShapeContext`, so only the refused-shape listing reads it (only with an `onTodo` sink). The `external` detector reads the stack's own `datasources` first, then the map. `refused-shapes.ts` stays internal (not re-exported).
- **`surface` string** now reads "…on the primary datasource, or on a managed one the stack declares or the caller resolves (a stored or registered datasource)".

## Measure first (base `c9be979dd`)

1. **The save door** (`externalBindingSaveRefusal`, object half): one read, `readMetaItem({ type: 'datasource', name })`. That read takes the environment's active stored row first and falls back to the code layer's definition (the MetadataService registration, then the registry). A code-defined datasource name declines a stored row (`declinesStoredRow`), so the code definition wins there.
2. **The pass** (`migrateStoredMetadata`): it reads every `active` and `draft` `sys_metadata` row in two queries before the loop. So the stored datasource rows are in reach before any object row is converted. The pass now uses the door's own read for each object row, so registered datasources and the code-wins rule are covered too.
3. **Census of `onTodo` callers:** `applyConversionsToStoredItem` is called with a sink only by `convertStoredItemDetailed` (the pass). The other sink, `canonicalizeStoredFlow` in `service-automation`, goes through `applyConversionsToFlow` over `{ flows: [...] }`, which the `external` detector never reads. Neither changes behaviour without the new option.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts` (+7): a stored row on a known datasource declared `'managed'`, or with no `schemaMode`, is listed once and not rewritten. A known `'external'` or `'validate-only'` datasource, or one the row does not name, is not listed. A datasource the stack declares is read before the caller's. Without an `onTodo` sink the map is never read.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.external-binding-named-datasource-refusal.test.ts` (+6). An object row is planted straight into the `sys_metadata` double (stored before the door existed), and then `migrateStoredMetadata` runs in preview. Pinned cases:
  - on a stored managed datasource (both shapes), the row is listed `skipped` with this entry's TODO at `objects[0].external`, and the same body offered to `saveMetaItem` is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `external`;
  - on a registered managed datasource, the row is listed;
  - when a stored federated row overlays a registered managed definition, the row is not listed and the save goes through;
  - on a federated stored datasource, or one no layer holds, the row is not listed (the card's control).
- **Full runs:** `@objectstack/spec` test 708 files / 21527 tests passed, typecheck exit 0. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` test 258 files / 20921 tests passed, typecheck exit 0.
- **Ablation, protocol half:** the pass's `await this.storedRowKnownDatasources(singular, body)` was replaced with `undefined` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `919137f3` → `cad58c17`). Result: 3 failed / 25 passed, with the three listing pins red and every control green. This is the base behaviour of the pass. Restore proven: blob == HEAD `919137f3`, `git diff HEAD` empty. `@objectstack/spec` resolved to a `dist/` built from this branch.
- **Ablation, spec half:** the detector's `?? context.knownDatasources?.get(name)` was dropped (anchor 1 → 0, blob `a387f79e` → `39524e03`). Result: 2 failed / 60 passed, the two listing pins red. Restore proven: blob == HEAD `a387f79e`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `src` relatively.

## Gates

All local readings were taken on head `aa0ca3a33` (the final commit, `origin/main` `49185cdb8` merged in).

- **Derived subset:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 88 families. `--ran` reconciliation: "88 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 87 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". 87 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it loads every package's `dist`, and this worktree built only the closure), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI.
- **Two re-runs after their prerequisites:** on the first pass `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow history; the named commit was fetched) and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` (`@objectstack/objectql` not yet built) exited 3. Both exit 0 on re-run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", against a `dist` built from this branch without `OS_SKIP_DTS`.
- CI families: this PR's check-runs. They were in progress when it opened.

## Acceptance notes

- **The datasource side is listed only through its objects.** The datasource save door also refuses re-saving a stored datasource as managed while objects bind it `external`. The pass lists the pair at each object row, not at the datasource row. Either fix the owner chooses (federate the datasource, or drop `external`) clears both. A datasource-row TODO would need its own D3 id and was not asked for.
- **Draft object rows** are judged against the active datasource, as the door judges a draft save. Organization-scoped rows are skipped before this step, as before.
- **One read per object row with `external`**, not cached across rows. The read is the door's own, and an `apply` run may rewrite rows between two object rows.
- **The semantic entry's acceptance criteria** already said `os migrate meta --stored` lists each such row. That sentence is now true for stored and registered datasources, so the entry is unchanged and the second branch's guidance edit is not needed.
- **File surface:** `packages/spec/src/conversions/apply.ts` was added to the claim's declared surface. The option has to pass through `applyConversions` to reach the detector. The seat was told before the edit.
